subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Number 0 (zero) and number 10: counts, recognises and matches 0 to 10

show.line: Ten little dinosaur eggs. Crack, crack! Now the nest is empty. Empty means zero.

rounds.prompt: Count on with me. Seven, eight, nine. What comes next?
How many lizards are on the rock? There are none. Say the number.
Count the snakes in the grass.
Count back with me. Three, two, one. What comes next?

hints: Touch each one as you count.
When there are none left, that is zero.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the empty nest.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The nest is empty. That is zero.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. No eggs at all. That is zero!

parent_line: Can count to 10 and knows that none is zero.
